title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ الددو يحاضر عن تراث الآل الأصحاب في مؤتمر علمي بالكويت
title_en: His Eminence Sheikh al-Dedew Lectures on the Heritage of the Prophet's Family and Companions at a Scholarly Conference in Kuwait
body_ar:
ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو محاضرة تحت عنوان: "النظرات المنهجية حول تراث الآل والأصحاب من الناحيتين العقدية والفقهية" متوقفا مع المذاهب الأربعة وعلاقتها بآل البيت.

تأتي هذه المحاضرة ضمن فعاليات النسخة الثانية من مؤتمر "السابقون الأولون ومكانتهم لدى المسلمين" والذي ينظمه الملتقى العالمي للعلماء والمفكرين المسلمين التابع لرابطة العالم الإسلامي بالتعاون مع وزارة الأوقاف الكويتية ومبرة الآل والأصحاب في الكويت، وذلك في الفترة من 25 إلى 27 محرم 1433هـ الموافق 20 إلى 22 ديسمبر 2011 في فندق الشيراتون بمدينة الكويت العاصمة.

ويستضيف المؤتمر أكثر من 60 شخصية إسلامية من مختلف الدول العربية والإسلامية؛ ممن لهم باع طويل في تراث آل البيت والأصحاب، وقد شارك الشيخ في فعاليات المؤتمر كضيف رئيسي بوصفه حفظه الله أحد العلماء الربانيين الذين يرجع إليهم في تبيين الرأي الوسط بالنسبة لموضوع الآل والأصحاب الشائك بين آراء أهل السنة واعتبارات الشيعة.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew delivered a lecture under the title: "Methodological perspectives on the heritage of the Family and the Companions, from the creedal and the juristic sides", dwelling on the four schools of law and their relation to the Family of the House.

This lecture comes among the proceedings of the second edition of the conference "The first forerunners and their standing among the Muslims", organised by the International Forum for Muslim Scholars and Thinkers, affiliated to the Muslim World League, in cooperation with the Kuwaiti Ministry of Endowments and the Mabarrat al-Al wa-l-Ashab in Kuwait, in the period from 25 to 27 Muharram 1433 AH, corresponding to 20 to 22 December 2011, at the Sheraton Hotel in Kuwait City.

The conference hosts more than 60 Islamic figures from various Arab and Muslim countries, from among those with long experience in the heritage of the Family of the House and the Companions. The Sheikh took part in the conference's proceedings as a principal guest, in his standing — may God preserve him — as one of the godly scholars to whom recourse is had in setting out the middle view on the thorny subject of the Family and the Companions, between the views of the People of the Sunnah and the considerations of the Shia.

flags.arabic: أحد العلماء الربانيين الذين يرجع إليهم في تبيين الرأي الوسط بالنسبة لموضوع الآل والأصحاب الشائك بين آراء أهل السنة واعتبارات الشيعة
flags.context: the site's description of why the Sheikh was invited
options: display only with the record's own framing intact, and never as his position on the subject
display as an ordinary news item
flags.note: critical_for_display. The record announces that the Sheikh lectured on the most sectarian-sensitive subject in the corpus and gives not one word of what he said. All a reader gets is the site's own claim that he is a scholar who sets out the middle view between Sunni and Shia positions. That claim is the site's, not his, and a page that lets it stand as the content of the lecture puts a position on Sunni–Shia relations in his mouth. Read this record alongside 766 in this same span, where the same Sheikh is reported warning his congregation against Shi'ism in the strongest terms: the two together are why neither may be published as a statement of his view. Which he actually held, and how the two fit together, is settled by neither record.

flags.context: the lecture title and the conference's subject
options: the Family and the Companions / the Family of the House
the Prophet's household and his Companions
flags.note: الآل and آل البيت are the Prophet's family, and the pair الآل والأصحاب is a fixed formula that the corpus should render one way throughout. 'Family of the House' is a literal calque of آل البيت that will puzzle a reader without the gloss the record does not give; 'the Prophet's household' is clearer but drops the formula. Flagged rather than settled here because the formula is doctrinally loaded and the choice should be made centrally.

flags.arabic: مبرة الآل والأصحاب في الكويت / الملتقى العالمي للعلماء والمفكرين المسلمين
options: keep the Arabic names transliterated, as done here for the Mabarrah
flags.note: A مبرة is a charitable foundation. The Mabarrat al-Al wa-l-Ashab is a named Kuwaiti institution whose own English style is not known from the record, so it is transliterated rather than translated; the Forum and the League are rendered by their established English names. A reviewer able to check the institutions' own materials should confirm all three.

options: supply the missing conjunction in the English title only
flags.note: The headline drops the و between الآل and الأصحاب, which the body has correctly as الآل والأصحاب. title_ar preserves the source's defective form; title_en reads as the body does. Recorded rather than silently repaired.

translator_notes: A short news report of a conference paper. It gives the paper's title and nothing of its content, so no ruling and no creedal position is stated anywhere in the record.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date and is not evidence of when the report was written. The body's hijri and Gregorian date ranges agree with each other and with the timestamp.
العقدية is from ʿaqīdah, creed, and is rendered 'creedal' to keep it distinct from الفقهية, 'juristic'. The distinction is the structure of the lecture title.
وزارة الأوقاف is rendered 'the Ministry of Endowments', following the glossary's waqf.

السابقون الأولون, the conference's title, is the Qur'anic phrase for the first Muslims (Sūrat al-Tawbah 9:100). It is not quoted as scripture here and is not marked as a quotation; no locator is given.
